newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares post big gains ahead of rate rise.
newsitem.headline: French shares post big gains ahead of rate rise.

text.p: French shares closed much higher on Tuesday ahead of an expected decision by the Federal Reserve Open Market Committee (FOMC) to raise U.S. interest rates by 0.25 percentage points, dealers said.
A strong start on Wall Street underpinned the French rise.
The CAC-40 index closed 44.97 points, or 1.74 percent, higher at 2,624.25.
Dealers said they were rather surprised by the strength of today's rally, but said the market was up in line with Treasury bonds, Wall Street and other markets.
"A quarter point rise has been discounted. People do not expect a bigger rise," a broker said.
A U.S. rate decision is not expected before 1900 GMT.
Volume was 6.72 billion francs including 4.78 billion in CAC-40 shares.
The March CAC future gained 25.5 points to 2,627.5.

Lyonnaise and Cie de Suez remained active due to merger speculation. Lyonnaise closed 0.35 percent down at 572 francs and Suez gained 1.33 percent to 281 francs after an article in Le Monde suggested that the merger would take the form of a Lyonnaise bid for Suez, instead of the other way around.
"We will hear a lot of different stories on this one before it is over. People are covering themselves for whatever eventuality," a broker said.
Damart was the biggest riser of the day with 8.67 percent increase to 4,825 francs after a strong increase in its first half profits.
